collection_declaration.attribution: Upstream README at source_commit; labels and collection claims are not independently verified.
collection_declaration.scope: 18 candidate labels, two families; closed-set attribution with uniform prior.
collection_declaration.limitations: Unknown models still map to a known candidate. System prompts affect results; upstream reports significant Claude Code bias. No model authenticity or real-world accuracy claim.
collection_declaration.local_collection: No model requests or new reference samples collected. Only statistical bank is distributed; reference.jsonl and prompts are excluded.

adaptations: Shared browser/Node ESM; bounded inputs and strict statistical schema validation.
Projection uses original vector for every basis dot product, matching Python simultaneous projection.
Unicode decimal digits follow Python regex/int behavior.
Challenge count restricted to 1–3; random IDs use Web Crypto getRandomValues.
Conditional probability is zero when family probability underflows to zero.
